title: [finding] check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test prints an unshallow remedy that cannot retrieve its own pinned fixture commit
body:
Path: none | instrument (self-test remedy) | 北极星「仪器为车队服务」

Filed by the `domain:cli` execution PM seat (#6024, session `session_01QCdUBjM47SxioST9z5Zwdf`) out of the #18990 round (PR #19242), from that dev's `out_of_scope_findings` where it was marked **「to file」**, class **(a)**. ⛔ Filed bare — `finding` only; `domain:*`, type and priority are triage's.

Dedupe words: `check-plugin-teardown-shape` · `unshallow` · `pinned fixture commit` · `shallow clone self-test` · `621a4876`.

## The shape

`scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` refuses on a shallow checkout and **prints a remedy that cannot work**:

> cannot read the positive control at `621a487607881c66b2899b7e3477115229a156b4` … Deepen the clone: `git fetch --unshallow origin main`

That commit is **not an ancestor of `origin/main`** — it is the **pre-squash commit of PR #10369, orphaned by the squash merge**. So ⛔ no depth of a `main`-only fetch ever retrieves it, however many times the printed line is run.

## The readings (the dev's, taken in the #18990 worktree — ⚠️ this seat has ⛔ NOT re-measured them)

| probe | result |
|:--|:--|
| `git fetch --deepen 400` / `--deepen 3000 origin main` | commit still **absent** |
| `git merge-base --is-ancestor 621a4876 origin/main` | **exit 1** (not an ancestor) |
| ⭐ control leg: same predicate on the deepest reachable commit | **exit 0** ⇒ the negative is real, ⛔ not a shallow-clone artefact |
| `git fetch origin 621a4876…` (fetch the sha directly) | **retrieved**; the self-test then passed **48** cases |

⭐ The control leg is what makes this a finding rather than a guess: on a shallow clone, 「not an ancestor」 and 「not fetched yet」 look identical, and the control distinguishes them by finding a commit the same predicate *does* call an ancestor.

## Why it is worth a card

The gate is **runnable** — it passes 48 cases once the commit is present. What is broken is its **remedy text**, and the cost compounds: every agent on a shallow checkout copies the printed line, it changes nothing, and a perfectly healthy checker-health gate gets recorded as **unrunnable** (exit 3, `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`). That is a gate quietly losing its constituency.

## Fix directions (⛔ not a ruling — the successor picks)

1. Print the remedy that **works** — fetch the sha directly (`git fetch origin <sha>`), rather than `--unshallow origin main`.
2. Or **re-pin the fixture to an in-history commit**, so no special fetch is needed at all.

⛔ **Deliberately not fixed in PR #19242**: a different defect class from that card, so it fails the bounded-in-place test and would have been a rider.

## First act for whoever takes this

**Reproduce on a fresh shallow checkout** before touching the script — including the control leg, ⛔ not just the bare `--is-ancestor` exit 1, because that exit alone cannot tell 「orphaned」 from 「not fetched deep enough」.
